name: 92307 · Apple Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 92307 (Apple Valley) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92307 (Apple Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92307 (Apple Valley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
